_note: Themes built from three sets of keys (README "Themes"): the palette (the same 11 keys and light flag as lecture.json, sampled from our own material, contrast as in 新增色票), a shape (cards, captions, photos, keyword pills) and a ground (background and texture), plus the VE look their VE shots use. doc_themes.py turns each into a code theme of the same name.

dark-gold._why: a host shot at a wooden desk by lamplight: the dark wood is the ground, the scroll paper the text, the lamp flame pushed to gold the main colour, its copper rim the second

newsroom._why: our current-affairs thumbnails: charcoal frames, white headlines, the yellow label strip as the main colour and the blue of the channel badge, deepened, as the second

vintage-poster._why: a 1915 Bible atlas plate (public domain): the yellowed paper is the ground, its brown lettering the text, the pink and green region tints pushed to poster strength the main and second colours

editorial-serif._why: a prayer series cover card: cream paper, dark serif title, the plum day label as the main colour and the warm grey of its thin divider, deepened, as the second

cinematic-dark._why: a dark VE still of a darkened sky over a hill: near-black ground, the pale stone grey lifted as the text, the slate violet of the clouds lightened as the main colour, the warm grey as the second
